controlled_value_policy: Values column is authoritative; values are case-sensitive.

fields.name: Legal Fund Name Including Umbrella
fields.description:
Legal name of the collective investment scheme as mentioned in official documents (i.e. prospectus). If the fund belongs to an umbrella, the name of the umbrella must be included, too. Umbrella and sub-fund's name should be separated by " - ", i.e. "blank" (ASCII 32) "dash" (ASCII 45) "blank" (ASCII 32). Where the umbrella name is already incorporated into the legal sub-fund name as defined in the fund prospectus, it is advisable to omit any additional repetition in order to prevent overly long fund names and to ensure clarity and readability.

In combination with the fund's domicile (OFST010010 Fund Domicile Alpha-2) the Legal Fund Name should be unique in order to avoid mix-ups in cases where no identifier like an ISIN is available.

This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST010020(zh-Hant) for Legal Fund Name Including Umbrella written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.
fields.values_text: Fund name as mentioned in the prospectus including umbrella's name.

fields.name: Share Class Extension
fields.description:
Identifier of the share class. Usually this is one or two letters, like "A" or "B" or "XL" followed by additional information about distribution policy, hedging, currency etc.

This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST020050(zh-Hant) for Share Class Extension written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

fields.name: ISIN
fields.description: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) of the share class (e.g. LU0000000000). Please take good care, that an ISIN may include only upper case letters.
fields.tags: EFT | RG97 | EPT | Essential | TPT | EMT

fields.name: Term Grouping Key
fields.description: An ID that can be used to link multiple rules into a single group. E.g. linking a redemption restriction and a redemption in kind together, where they apply as one set of restrictions and penalties in the fund prospectus. Should be assigned as a GUID by a given user and not reused for other term by their system. As openfunds does not store data, there is no way to make this a universal GUID; this should be managed per user.
fields.values_text: alphanumeric ID linking rows that are one logical rule

fields.name: Term Application Level
fields.description: Indicates whether the term is applicable at the Share Class or Investor level. There is deliberately no "Fund" value: where a rule applies across several share classes of a fund, it must be stated explicitly on each affected share class / ISIN rather than implied once at fund level (an implicit fund-level rule is easily misapplied when share classes are later added or removed). Note the term logic may be calculated on a different level from which it is applied (see also OFTC005250 "Term Calculation Level").

fields.name: Restriction or Penalty Term
fields.description:
Indicates which restriction or penalty term is outlined with the relevant details in this data set.

- Redemption restriction: A provision restricting redemptions per the specified terms, not to be confused with terms that allow restrictions with an applied penalty. Hard lockups in which redemptions are fully restricted for a specified period are an example of this.
- Redemption gate: A provision allowing the fund to limit the total amount that investors can redeem in a given period.
- Extension of notice periods: Indicates the fund's ability to extend the standard redemption notice period referenced in OFST410065 "Cut-Off Date Offset for Redemption".
- Redemption fee: A charge levied on redeeming investors, often expressed as a percentage of the redemption amount. Soft lockups in which redemptions are permitted but may result in penalties are an example of this.
- Subscription Anti-dilution levy: A charge applied to subscribing investors to protect existing investors from the costs associated with deploying new capital (e.g. transaction costs, stamp duty). Note that OFST454300 "Has Dilution Levy Applied By Fund" should be 'yes' if this option is selected.
- Redemption Anti-dilution levy: A charge applied to redeeming investors to protect remaining investors from the costs associated with liquidating assets to meet redemptions. Note that OFST454300 "Has Dilution Levy Applied By Fund" should be 'yes' if this option is selected.
- Redemption in kind: Indicates the fund may satisfy redemption requests by transferring assets (rather than cash) during periods of liquidity stress on the fund.
- Side pockets: A mechanism that segregates illiquid or hard-to-value assets into a separate account. Typically, investors cannot redeem from the side pocket until the assets are realised, protecting remaining investors from dilution.
- Suspension of subscriptions, repurchases and redemptions: Indicates the fund may temporarily halt all subscriptions, repurchases, and redemptions in exceptional circumstances.
- Holdback: A term indicating that percentage of the redemption proceeds may be withheld at the time of redemption and paid out at a later date, usually once final NAV calculations or asset valuations are confirmed.
- Payout delay: The settlement of redemption proceeds is deferred beyond the standard payment date. Unlike a holdback, the full amount is expected to be paid, but the timing is extended.
- Minimum retention: the fund requires an investor's remaining invested capital not to fall below a specified floor (see OFTC005410 "Minimum Investment Retention Requirement"); breaching the floor results in the action stated in OFTC005420 "Minimum Investment Retention Violation Result", typically compulsory redemption of the remaining position. The OFTC005410/005420 pair may either form a standalone row (with this value in OFTC005020) or be populated alongside another term's rows as a class-level attribute.
- Large redemption: a provision that classifies “large redemptions” such that redemptions exceeding a specified trigger will result in a change to how or when they are processed.
- Other: only choose other in case none of the above fits, and ensure that you properly describe the term in OFTC005040 and OFTC005050.
fields.values_text: "Redemption restriction" / "Redemption gate" / "Extension of notice periods" / "Redemption fee" / "Subscription anti-dilution levy" / "Redemption anti-dilution levy" / "Redemption in kind" / "Side pockets" / "Suspension of subscriptions, repurchases and redemptions" / "Holdback" / "Payout delay" / "Minimum retention" / "Large redemption" / "other"
allowed_values: Suspension of subscriptions, repurchases and redemptions

fields.name: Reference to ESMA LMT
fields.description:
This optional field captures the reference to the Liquidity Management  Tool (LMT) chosen according to the ESMA Guidelines (OFST351350 "ESMA Liquidity Management Tools"). In contrast to OFST351350, this field expects only one field value; the one which is the correct reference to the LMT. 

Leave blank if not applicable.
fields.values_text: "Redemption gate" / "Extension of notice periods" / "Redemption fee" / "Swing pricing" / "Dual pricing" / "Anti-dilution levy" / "Redemption in kind"

fields.name: Term Short Description
fields.description: Provides a brief description of the type of redemption related term.

fields.name: Term Full Description
fields.description:
This optional field captures the relevant wording describing the referenced redemption restriction or penalty, as set out in the official offering documents. If the relevant information is spread across multiple sections, paragraphs or term items, please provide all relevant excerpts.

Example: 
For shares held in the ABC fund, the early redemption cost shall be calculated on the following tiered basis: (i) a 5% fee will be applied if the redemption request is received within 12 months of the Subscription Date; (ii) a 4% fee will be applied if the redemption request is received after 12 months and within 24 months of the Subscription Date; and (iii) a 3% fee will be applied if the redemption request is received after 24 months of the Subscription Date.

fields.name: Term Time Characteristic
fields.description: Indicates how the restriction or penalty is applied from a time period perspective. Note that "Perpetual" should only be used if the restriction or penalty applies for the entire life of the Share class. If instead, it only applies after a specified period then the "Specified Period" option should be selected instead. For example, if a redemption penalty of 2% applies for the first year and is subsequently reduced to 1% in perpetuity, two separate rows of data should be utilized to capture the relevant fee for each period and both rows should utilize the "Specified Period" option.

fields.name: Term Frequency
fields.description: Frequency of recurring time period for which the restriction or penalty is applicable. For example, if investors are limited to redeeming 10% of their position per quarter, the value indicated here should be "Quarterly" to indicate that the restriction is calculated and applied per quarter. Only applies if OFTC005110 "Term Time Characteristic" selected is "Recurring Frequency".
fields.values_text: "daily" / "twice a week" / "weekly" / "twice a month" / "monthly" / "every two months" / "quarterly" / "twice a year" / "annually"

fields.name: Term Period Start Day Offset
fields.description:
Beginning number of days, counted from the OFTC005220 "Term Reference Date Basis", from which the penalty/restriction applies. The reference date itself is day 0, so a term that applies from the outset has a Term Period Start Date of 0. Counts are actual calendar days (or business days, per OFTC005160) - not a 30-day-month / 360-day-year approximation; terms expressed in months or years are converted to their actual elapsed-day equivalent (1 year = 365 days: 12 months = 365, 24 months = 730, 36 months = 1,095). 
Only applies if OFTC005110 "Term Time Characteristic" selected is "Specified Period". Please choose calendar or business days in field OFTC005160 "Calendar or Business Days for Term Period" if this field is used.

fields.name: Term Period End Day Offset
fields.description:
Ending number of days, counted from the OFTC005220 "Term Reference Date Basis" (reference date = day 0), through which the penalty or restriction applies; the end day is inclusive. Counts are actual calendar days (or business days, per OFTC005160) - not a 30-day-month / 360-day-year approximation (e.g. 12 months = day 365). Consecutive bands should run end-to-start+1 (e.g. year 1 = 0-365, year 2 = 366-730). 
Only applies if OFTC005110 "Term Time Characteristic" selected is "Specified Period". Please choose calendar or business days in field OFTC005160 "Calendar or Business Days for Term Period" if this field is used.

fields.name: Calendar or Business Days for Term Period
fields.description: This field defines whether the period of days stated in OFTC005140 "Term Period Start Day Offset" and OFTC005150 "Term Period End Day Offset" refer to calendar days or to business days. A single basis applies to both fields; it is not possible to specify different bases for Start Day- and End Day Offset. Required if OFTC005140 "Term Period Start Day Offset" is populated.

fields.name: Term Application From Period Start in Perpetuity
fields.description: Indicate "yes" only if the term (or the state it establishes) continues indefinitely from the specified OFTC005140 "Term Period Start Day Offset" with no end - for example a final tranche release that remains redeemable thereafter, or a reduced fee that then applies for all time. Do not use this flag, or add a row, merely to signal that a preceding term has ended: if no period band covers a given time, no term applies to it and no row is required. Only applies if OFTC005110 "Term Time Characteristic" selected is "Specified Period"; when "yes", leave OFTC005150 "Term Period End Day Offset" blank.

fields.name: Term Reference Date OFID
fields.description:
If applicable, the OFID of the field that this term references to (i.e. "OFST020560" - Share Class Launch Date). openfunds recommends to use this field preferred over OFTC005220 "Term Reference Date Basis" and OFTC005230 "Term Actual Reference Date", if possible. 
If OFTC005210 is populated, OFTC005220 and OFTC005230 are expected to be left blank.

fields.name: Term Reference Date Basis
fields.description: The reference date that is the basis upon which the specified period is counted (i.e. Investor's Subscription Date). Required if OFTC005210 "Term Reference Date OFID" is empty or not applicable.

fields.name: Term Actual Reference Date
fields.description: The actual date being referenced. Required if OFTC005210 "Term Reference Date OFID" is empty or not applicable.

fields.name: Term Calculation Level
fields.description:
The level at which the logic for the penalty/restriction is calculated or determined upon.
- Fund: The restriction or penalty is assessed at the level of the entire fund, for example based on the fund’s NAV. If the relevant scope extends beyond a single fund and is measured across parallel vehicles of the same issuer, select "Fund" as the calculation level in this field and specify the exact perimeter as free text in OFTC005310 "Term Basis".
- Share Class: The restriction or penalty applies uniformly across all investors in a given share class. For example, a redemption gate that suspends or pro-rates redemptions when total requests across all investors in Class A Shares exceed 10% of that share class's NAV in a given quarter. The gate is triggered by collective redemption pressure across the entire class - no individual investor's behaviour alone determines the outcome.
- Investor: The restriction or penalty is assessed against each investor's overall position, regardless of when individual subscriptions were made. For example, a soft lockup that prohibits penalty-free redemption until an investor has held their position for at least 24 months from their first subscription date. An investor who first subscribed in January 20X3 would be subject to the lockup until January 20X5, regardless of any additional subscriptions made after that date, because the restriction references the investor's initial entry point into the fund, not each individual subscription.
- Subscription Tranche: The restriction or penalty is assessed against each individual subscription separately, an approach often referred to as "lot-level" accounting. Each subscription an investor makes creates a distinct Subscription Tranche or Investment Lot. An "Investment Lot" is a commonly used term that is equivalent to a Subscription Tranche. For the purpose of this field, a Subscription Tranche is defined as a record of an investor's capital contribution that serves as the baseline for applying time-based restrictions or penalties. This record is uniquely identified by its critical attributes, the purchase date and -amount (or number of shares/units). Each lot therefore carries its own independent holding period clock calculated from its specific purchase date, and has a distinct cost basis, calculated from its specific purchase date.
For example, an early redemption penalty of 3% applied to any capital withdrawn within 18 months of its subscription date. An investor who subscribed in March 20X3 and again in September 20X3, and who seeks to redeem both in November 20X4, would find the March 20X3 subscription (held for 20 months) exempt from the penalty, while the September 20X3 subscription (held for 14 months) would incur the full 3% fee, because each subscription carries its own independent holding period clock.

fields.name: Term Percentage
fields.description:
The applicable percentage of the term, entered as a positive decimal fraction only (e.g. 0.03 for 3%, 0.5 for 50%; never a whole number such as 3 to mean 3%), of the basis stated in OFTC005310 "Term Basis" (which must be populated whenever this field is used). The percentage is always positive; whether it represents a cost, a cap, a permitted portion or a withheld portion is determined by the value of OFTC005020 "Restriction or Penalty Term":
- Redemption restriction: the cumulative proportion of the holding permitted to be redeemed by the end of the band, rather than the increment released during it (0 = fully blocked, 0.5 = half the holding redeemable in total at that point, 1 = the whole amount). 
- Redemption gate: the cap - the maximum proportion of the basis redeemable in the period
- Redemption fee: the fee rate charged to the redeeming investor
- Subscription anti-dilution levy: the levy rate charged on the subscription amount
- Redemption anti-dilution levy: the levy rate charged on the redemption amount
- Holdback: the proportion of redemption proceeds withheld
- Extension of notice periods / Redemption in kind / Side pockets / Suspension / Payout delay / Minimum retention: not used - leave blank
fields.values_text: Percentage described as a decimal figure only (e.g. 3% = 0.03, 50% = 0.5), rounded to a maximum of 7 digits after the decimal point.

fields.name: Term Basis
fields.description: The basis upon which the percentage applies and is calculated. For example, if the term indicates a redemption penalty calculated as 5% of NAV, the base indicated here is "NAV". Required whenever OFTC005300 "Term Percentage" is populated, so the denominator of the percentage is always explicit (e.g. NAV of shares redeemed, investor NAV in the share class, shares/units held).

fields.name: Term-related Monetary Amount
fields.description: Indicates a static monetary value upon which the term is applied. For example, a redemption gate may be specified as a limit by a specific monetary value.

fields.name: Term-related Monetary Amount Currency
fields.description: The currency of the monetary value upon which the term is applied, when applicable. Only applies if OFTC005320 Term-related Monetary Amount is not blank.
fields.values_text: One of the currencies as it can be found on the list of currencies of ISO code 4217, as per https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html.

fields.name: Term Trigger
fields.description:
Indicates a threshold condition over which a fee, penalty or restriction applies. Use this field for ANY triggering condition whose result is a fee, penalty or restriction (a charge, or the blocking/limiting of redemption) - whether the condition is a recurring proportional cap (e.g. redemptions above 25% of the shareholder's NAV in any single dealing period) OR a one-off size threshold on a single redemption (e.g. a redemption exceeding 5% of the investor's shares held) and describe the condition in free text. 
For a size-triggered surcharge, set the row's Restriction or Penalty Term (OFTC005020) to its existing value "Redemption fee", with OFTC005300 "Term Percentage" and OFTC005310 "Term Basis", and state the size condition here. Use OFTC005440 "Large Redemption Trigger" instead of this field only where exceeding the threshold results in a delay / deferred execution rather than a fee, penalty or restriction. Where a trigger has more than one leg (e.g. "the higher of EUR 5,000,000 and 3% of Fund NAV"), describe the full condition here in free text; the absolute monetary leg may optionally also be recorded in OFTC005320 / OFTC005330.
fields.example: Redemption requests greater than 3% of Investor NAV

fields.name: Minimum Investment Retention Requirement
fields.description: Indicate if the fund has a minimum investment retention requirement below which the investor's remaining invested capital must not fall, and which - if breached - triggers the action in OFTC005420 "Minimum Investment Retention Violation Result" (typically compulsory redemption). This is the floor that triggers that action; it is not the minimum initial or subsequent subscription amount, which is a separate concept. Currency should be the same as OFST020540 "Share Class Currency".

fields.name: Minimum Investment Retention Violation Result
fields.description: Resulting action taken by the fund if the minimum investment retention is violated.

fields.name: Large Redemption Trigger
fields.description:
In some instances, a share class defines a "Large Redemption" as a redemption exceeding a certain threshold that triggers a delay or deferred execution of the redemption request. Use this field - together with OFTC005450 "Large Redemption Trigger Result", OFTC005470 "Large Redemption Delay in Days" and OFTC005480 "Calendar or Business Days for Large Redemption Delays" - only where the result of exceeding the threshold is a delay/deferral. 

Describe the triggering condition(s) here (e.g. "redemptions greater than 5% of Investor NAV"); note there may be multiple conditions. 

If exceeding the threshold instead results in a fee, penalty or restriction (not a delay), use OFTC005340 "Term Trigger" instead. Where the threshold is compound (e.g. "the higher of EUR 5,000,000 and 3% of Fund NAV"), describe it here in free text; the absolute monetary leg may optionally also be recorded in OFTC005320 / OFTC005330. If not applicable, leave blank.

If this field is completed, ensure that OFTC005020 "Restriction or Penalty Term" is set to "Large Redemption".
fields.example: Redemption requests greather than 5M EUR or 3% of Fund NAV

fields.name: Large Redemption Trigger Result
fields.description: Indicates the result of the large redemption trigger being activated. Only applies if OFTC005440 "Large Redemption Trigger" is not blank and OFTC005020 "Restriction or Penalty Term" is set to "Large Redemption".

fields.name: Large Redemption Delay in Days
fields.description:
Indicates if the large redemption triggers a delay in the execution of the redemption by a number of days. Only applies if OFTC005440 "Large Redemption Trigger" is not blank and OFTC005020 "Restriction or Penalty Term" is set to "Large Redemption".

Please choose calendar or business days in field OFTC005480 "Calendar or Business Days for Large Redemption Delays".

fields.name: Calendar or Business Days for Large Redemption Delays
fields.description: This field defines whether the period of days stated in OFTC005470 "Large Redemption Delay in Days" refers to calendar days or to business days. Only applies if OFTC005440 "Large Redemption Trigger" is not blank and OFTC005020 "Restriction or Penalty Term" is set to "Large Redemption".

fields.name: Term Valid From
fields.description:
Optional field indicating the date from which this term condition is valid. If left blank, no start date restriction applies. The term is considered currently applicable if OFTC008010 "Term Valid From" is blank or is on or before the current date, and OFTC008020 "Term Valid To" is blank or is on or after the current date.

If a data transmission is intended to provide only the current terms and conditions, without historical data, openfunds recommends using this field for storage or reference purposes only and not as part of the ongoing data transmission. Historical, current, and future values require careful and consistent handling to ensure that the recipient’s system is updated correctly with each submission.

fields.name: Term Valid To
fields.description:
Optional field indicating the date until which this term condition is valid. Only applicable if OFTC008010 "Term Valid From" is completed. If left blank, no end date restriction applies. The term is considered currently applicable if OFTC008020 "Term Valid To" is blank or is on or after the current date, provided that OFTC008010 "Term Valid From" is on or before the current date.

If a data transmission is intended to provide only the current terms and conditions, without historical data, openfunds recommends using this field for storage or reference purposes only and not as part of the ongoing data transmission. Historical, current, and future values require careful and consistent handling to ensure that the recipient’s system is updated correctly with each submission.
